newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial $500 mln in deals reviewed.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial $500 mln in deals reviewed.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said more than $500 million of potential transactions are under review as it pursues an opportunistic acquisition strategy.
"As First Industrial's franchise expands, we see a steady increase in acquisition and development opportunities," Michael Tomasz, president, said in a statement.
First Industrial acquired approximately $185 million of industrial properties in the first nine months of 1996, which are expected to provide returns in excess of 11 percent.
Development projects also continue to be a significant component of First Industrial's growth, the company said.

In September, it formed Development Services Group (DSG), a wholly owned subsidiary that will service First Industrial's increased customer demand for build-to-suits, oversee redevelopment and expansion of existing buildings, and expand present development capabilities.

Earlier, First Industrial, a real estate comapny that owns, acquires and manages bulk warehouse and light industrial properties, reported third quarter funds from operations of $0.59 a share, compared with $0.54 a year ago.
Its net profit was $0.32 a share, compared with a loss of $0.05 last year.
Shares and units outstanding in the quarter rose to 26.3 million in the third quarter from 20.4 million a year ago.
Revenues for the third quarter rose 33.7 percent to $36.2 million.
